summary: Mark Beshore, Nederland resident, overexerted after his snowmobile stuck in a snowdrift near Nederland; hiked to a cabin at Arapaho Ranch, suffered cardiac arrest, was revived by bystander CPR and Nederland Fire paramedics (defibrillation), then flown by Med Evac helicopter to Boulder Community Hospital; received a stent and fully recovered.
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District; Med Evac (helicopter)
